final_hypotheses.title: Guitar Morning, Separate Evenings; Hana Does Not Cook
final_hypotheses.prose:
Hana's weekday morning is dedicated to guitar practice in bedroom_b1 from 6:30 to 9:00. She does not cook; she heats a mug of tea and eats a piece of fruit from the fruit bowl. She leaves at 13:40 without taking much—just her tablet (which she uses at work) and a water bottle. Priya handles all cooking: breakfast 7:00–7:30, lunch 12:00–13:00, and a light dinner 18:00–18:30. In the evening after Hana returns at 23:00, they do not watch TV together. Hana goes to her bedroom, plays guitar 23:30–00:30, then sleeps. Priya reads at the coffee table or watches TV alone 21:00–22:30, then goes to bed at 22:45. On weekends, Hana sleeps until 8, does errands 11:00–14:00 (taking her jacket, keys, and shopping bag), and practices guitar in the afternoon. Priya walks 10:00–12:00.

What sets this apart: the guitar is in active use (bedroom_floor_b1, but the resident is in the room) from 6:30–9:00 weekdays. The remote stays at tv_stand_l1 even in the evening—no shared TV. The blanket never moves to the couch.

What would refute it: remote_shared found at coffee_table_l1 between 21:00 and 23:00; blanket_shared found at couch_l1 at 21:00; guitar_hana found at a location other than bedroom_floor_b1 at 7:00 on a weekday.

final_hypotheses.title: The Shared Breakfast Table; Hana Packs Lunch, Priya Does Light Dinners

Hana then packs a lunchbox and works from home at desk_b1 until 12:30. She leaves at 13:40 with her tablet, a sandwich, and her water bottle. Priya cooks a light lunch for herself at 12:30. In the afternoon Priya does errands 14:00–15:30. At 18:00 Priya makes a simple dinner (soup, salad) for both—Hana eats when she gets home at 23:00, or it's reheated. Evening: they watch TV together 23:15–00:15, then Hana plays guitar 00:15–01:00, Priya reads until 22:30 (she goes to bed before Hana returns on weekdays, so the TV is really just for Hana on weeknights). On weekends they have a proper brunch 10:30–12:00, Hana does errands 13:00–15:00, and they play a board game 19:00–20:30.

What sets this apart: the puzzle_box moves to the dining table on weekends 19:00–20:30. The cooking items (pan, knife, cutting board) are at the counter 7:00–7:45 weekdays (shared breakfast). Hana's notebook is at desk_b1 all morning.

She heats a leftover or grabs a quick snack at the counter but does not cook a full meal. At 13:30 she grabs her water_bottle_priya (shared kitchen bottle), her jacket (not yet seen—will appear as she comes home), and her tablet, and leaves at 13:40. She is OUT_OF_HOUSE from 13:40 to 23:00. Priya walks the dog from 7:00 to 8:00 (leash and dog_toy go out with her), returns, cooks a simple breakfast, then a proper lunch around 12:00. In the afternoon she does light errands 14:00–16:00 (keys, wallet, jacket, sunglasses leave with her). Evening: both are home by 23:00. They watch TV together 23:15–00:30 (remote, blanket, snack bowl migrate to the coffee table/couch). Hana plays guitar in her bedroom 00:30–01:15 before bed. Priya reads at the coffee table until about 22:00, then goes to bed.

What sets this apart: the tablet and notebook are at desk_b1 on weekday mornings (6:30–12:30), not at the nightstand. The dog leash is OUT_OF_HOUSE 7:00–8:00 weekdays. Hana's water bottle is OUT_OF_HOUSE 13:40–23:00.

final_hypotheses.title: Standard split-shift; Priya anchors the home, Hana vanishes at 13:40
final_hypotheses.prose:
Two residents share this house on complementary schedules. Hana (30s) is home from waking (~06:30) until she leaves for her afternoon-to-night shift at roughly 13:40; she returns at 23:00. Priya (60s) is retired and home almost all day, with a morning walk (07:00–09:00) and an afternoon errand run (14:00–16:00) on weekdays; on weekends her walk shifts to late morning (10:00–12:00) and Hana handles midday errands (11:00–14:00). Meals are at 07:00, 12:30, and 18:30. Evening TV (19:00–22:00) is the main shared activity on the couch; Hana's guitar stays in her bedroom (b1) and she does not play it in the living room. Priya's camera stays on the bookshelf; she photographs at home or on the balcony. The yoga mat stays rolled in wardrobe_b2—Priya does not do yoga in the living room. Nothing leaves the house except Priya's keys, wallet, jacket, shoes, and sunglasses during her walks/errands, and Hana's umbrella if it rains.

What sets this apart: the guitar never leaves bedroom_floor_b1, the camera never leaves bookshelf_l1, and the yoga mat never leaves wardrobe_b2. Hana's notebook and tablet stay in her bedroom all day (she does not work at the desk in the morning). What would refute it: guitar_hana sighted at couch_l1, armchair_l1, or coffee_table_l1 at any hour; camera_priya sighted OUT_OF_HOUSE; yoga_mat_priya sighted at floor_l_l1 or bedroom_floor_b2.
